privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must test at least 30 poses. The output files must be located at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/grasp_evaluations.csv and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/optimal_grasp.json. The grasp quality score must be derived from the dot product of surface normals at contact points. Note that while 30 poses are required, there is no specific minimum number of 'valid' grasps (successful detections) mandated by the underlying task logic, though the JSON must report how many were found.
